text.p: Security Associates International Inc said Tuesday it acquired about 1,300 more alarm monitoring subscribers during January, 1997.
A spokesman said the company plans to increase its alarm monitoring subscriber base by another 50 percent in the next 90 days.
It said the new accounts will add about $30,000 of recurring monthly revenue. Substantially all of the subscribers are residential customers.
Security Associates now owns about 17,000 subscriber accounts. It also operates three third-party monitoring central stations with more than 110,000 subscribers.
